name: @catenahq/templates
description: Catena template catalog: one metadata file per template plus its compose file, rendered into the machine catalog (catalog.json), a static preview (index.html) and a Portainer-shaped index (templates.json v3). A host takes an app from a tag.

scripts.verify: uv run build/render.py && git diff --exit-code blueprints templates.json catalog.json index.html
